name: gunslinger-gun-training-levelups
description: DEF-04 / S4 T1. The product's own disposable-gunslinger-gun-training scenario, run in the disposable game copy with the candidate alone, at the main menu, in a fresh process. Besides its direct-fact controls (a Pistol Gun Training fact added directly: Dexterity damage and the Broken-state misfire), it levels detached chargen units through real LevelUpController visits (LevelUpState.IsComplete, then ApplyLevelup): a base Gunslinger to 17 with a cancelled level-9 visit, a Mysterious Stranger to 17, two constructed legacy states holding a hidden Rifle fact (compatibility controls, not an old save), and a Pistolero and a Musket Master to 17. It reads the published descriptions. No save is loaded or written.
